title: Final Electric Field Inside
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the electric field inside the sphere as E1 = (3*epsilon2/(epsilon1 + 2*epsilon2)) * E.

title: Final Electric Field Outside
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the electric field outside the sphere as E2 = E + ((epsilon1 - epsilon2)/(epsilon1 + 2*epsilon2)) * a^3 * [3*(E . r)*r/r^5 - E/r^3].

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the correct boundary conditions at r = a and as r approaches infinity.

title: Potential Functions
description: Important Criteria: The student should express the potentials Phi1 and Phi2 correctly using Legendre polynomials.

title: Symmetry Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The student should recognize the symmetry of the problem and use it to simplify the analysis.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of electric fields and potentials.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as dielectric constants, are included in the final expressions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explore alternative methods or approximations to verify the results.
